stock.description: Prosperous Printing Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of books and paper products to print brokers and publishers in Hong Kong, the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, and other European countries. The company offers case bound, soft bound, saddle stitch book, handcraft products, silk screening, finishing, cut and stamp, and accessories and other products. It is also involved in the property investment activities. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Chai Wan, Hong Kong. Prosperous Printing Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of First Tech Inc.
